profile.description: 2026 International Camel & Ostrich Races prospect. Family-friendly three-day event Sept. 11-13, 2026 at the Virginia City Fairgrounds, with four race shows and a Sunday Family Day. 2026 vendor/event management contact is Liquid Blue Events at team@liquidblueevents.com / 775-851-4444. Adventure Zone remains a reasonable 2026 route opportunity if space/logistics work; prepaid or pay-for-play may both be considered because the outreach is last-minute.

notes.subject: Aug. 27 outreach sent
notes.body: Desiree sent the personalized outreach to Liquid Blue Events at team@liquidblueevents.com on Aug. 27, 2026. Do not leave the Aug. 27 email action as still due after the message has been sent. Current official research confirms the event is Sept. 11-13, family-friendly, and includes Sunday Family Day. Give the email a short response window and then call/check back if needed because the event is close.

followUps.label: Call/check Camel & Ostrich Races after Aug. 27 email
followUps.reason: Personalized email was sent Aug. 27. If Liquid Blue Events has not replied by Monday Aug. 31, call 775-851-4444 to ask whether a staffed inflatable carnival opportunity still exists for Sept. 11-13. Keep both prepaid and pay-for-play available as workable last-minute structures.
